images.author: Jeffrey Beall
images.caption: The Peter Hansen House, located at 1123 East Capitol Street in Pierre, South Dakota. The house is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

facade.notes: the Peter Hansen House (a Lustron, Pierre SD, c.1949): enamelled steel panels -- grey above a darker wainscot band -- under a low steel hip roof, big windows, a corner entry; snow, Christmas lights and a wreath

why.note: the Lustron: enamelled-steel panels in grey, tan, blue, yellow or green, with a darker wainscot
